description_en: Queries the details of optimization suggestions. The operation applies only to the tickets for the data changes and SQL review
description_zh: 获取SQL审核优化建议的详情，适用于数据变更工单和SQLReview工单
name: GetSQLReviewOptimizeDetail

parameters.help_en: The key that is used to query the details of optimization suggestions. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257870.html operation to query the key
parameters.help_zh: 查询SQL审核优化建议详情信息。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257870.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: sql_review_query_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

OptimizeDetail.description_en: The details of optimization suggestions for SQL statements

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the database belongs

QualityResult.description_en: The quality of the SQL statement

OccurError.description_en:
Indicates whether an error occurs. Valid values:

true: An error occurs.
false: No error occurs
OccurError.description_zh:
是否遇到错误。返回值如下：
true：存在错误。
false：不存在错误

Results.description_en: The review results based on rules

Comments.description_en: The comment that is specified when you create the SQL review rule. For more information, see [SQL review optimization]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194114.html）
Comments.description_zh: 管理员进行SQL审核规则自定义配置时填写的备注信息。详细操作，请参见[SQL审核优化建议]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194114.html）
Comments.example: XXX business rules: Queries must include where conditions.

Feedback.description_en:
The optimization suggestion for the SQL statement. Valid values:

MUST_IMPROVE: The SQL statement must be improved.
POTENTIAL_ISSUE: The SQL statement contains potential issues.
SUGGEST_IMPROVE: We recommend that you improve the SQL statement.
USEDMSTOOLKIT: We recommend that you change schemas without locking tables.
USEDMSDML_UNLOCK: We recommend that you change data without locking tables.
TABLEINDEXSUGGEST: We recommend that you use SQL statements that use indexes
Feedback.description_zh:
SQL审核优化反馈结果。返回值如下：
MUST_IMPROVE：必须改进。
POTENTIAL_ISSUE：潜在问题。
SUGGEST_IMPROVE：建议改进。
USEDMSTOOLKIT：使用无锁结构变更。
USEDMSDML_UNLOCK：使用无锁数据变更。
TABLEINDEXSUGGEST：索引推荐

RuleName.description_en: The name of the rule. For more information, see [SQL review optimization]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194114.html）
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名。请参见[SQL审核优化建议]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194114.html）

RuleType.description_en:
The type of the SQL review rule. Valid values:

REVIEW: a rule that is used to review SQL statements based on standards.
OPTIMIZE: a rule that is used to provide optimization suggestions
RuleType.description_zh:
SQL审核规则。返回值如下：

REVIEW：规范审核。
OPTIMIZE：优化建议

Scripts.description_en: The SQL script for data changes
Scripts.description_zh: 某些规则附带生成变更脚本

Content.description_en: The content of the SQL script
Content.example: alter table xxx add index idx_xx(yyy);

OpType.description_en: The purpose of the SQL script. The value is set to AddIndex
OpType.description_zh: 执行脚本的目的。当前支持AddIndex（增加索引）

QueryKey.description_en: The key that is used to query the details of optimization suggestions
QueryKey.description_zh: SQL审核优化建议详情信息的查询KEY

SqlType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement. Valid values: DELETE, UPDATE, and ALTER_TABLE

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
